title: Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K Prefilled Kit Bundle
description: The Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K Bundle offers a complete vaping solution designed for exceptional flavour and reliable performance. This exclusive package includes two complete Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K Prefilled Pod Kits plus two additional Dojo Blast 10K Refill Pods. With four total 10ml units included, this bundle provides an extensive supply of hardware and e-liquid, ideal for vapers who want a reusable format that reduces waste. Each device is powered by a built-in 1000mAh battery and features USB-C fast charging for extended sessions with minimal downtime. The kit utilises a smart design where a 2ml prefilled pod is supported by an 8ml refill container, delivering up to 10,000 puffs per unit. The Smart Liq-Cycle system ensures efficient saturation of the coil to avoid dry hits, while the transparent pod design allows you to monitor e-liquid levels at a glance. Inside, Vaporesso’s COREX 2.0 dual mesh coil technology delivers consistent flavour delivery and dense vapour production. Designed for a smooth Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) draw, the Dojo Blast 10K replicates a cigarette-style sensation with simple inhale activation. Available Bundle Flavours: The bundle offers access to a wide range of prefilled 20mg nic salt flavours. Profiles range from unique citrus blends like Ten Tangerines and Pomelo Soda to rich fruit mixes like Triple Mango and Kiwi Passion Fruit Guava. For those preferring cooler notes, options like Watermelon Ice and Cool Menthol provide a crisp finish, while Classic Tobacco offers a smooth, earthy alternative. How To Set Up Your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K Device Step 1 Remove the device and refill components from the packaging. Step 2 Insert the 8ml refill container into the device. Step 3 Click the 2ml prefilled pod into place. Step 4 Allow the system to prime for a moment. Step 5 Inhale to vape. ✅ Ready to vape
